user.title: Connect to Fortify Platform
user.description: Paste an API key with the IoT / Sensors entitlement (Fortify Platform → Settings → API Keys → Create key).

location.title: Which location is this Home Assistant?
location.description: Sensor events from this site will belong to the location you pick. Room assignments happen in the platform's housing board, not here.

error.invalid_auth: The platform rejected this API key — check it has the IoT / Sensors entitlement.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Fortify Platform at that URL.
error.no_locations: The key works, but its service provider has no locations yet.
